attests.rateSchedule: STATUTORY STEP SCHEDULE as enacted by S.L. 2026-41 (SB 257) § 44.1(a), which rewrote G.S. 105-153.7(a): 2026 = 3.99%, 2027-2029 = 3.49%, 2030-2032 = 3.24%, after 2032 = 2.99%. The section STRUCK the prior open-ended 'After 2025 -- 3.99%' row. Effective when the act became law (ratified 2026-07-02, signed by the Governor 2026-07-07). The engine table transcribes this exactly as four held-forward steps (fromYear 2026/2027/2030/2033); a TY2027 lookup returns 0.0349.
attests.standardDeduction: $25,500 MFJ / $12,750 single -- fixed statutory dollars (G.S. 105-153.5(a)(1)), NOT inflation-indexed, NO age-65+/blindness add-on. Survivor transition halves MFJ -> single on the first death (rate unchanged). UNCHANGED by S.L. 2026-41 (§ 44.2 touches only the gambling-loss deduction).
attests.exemptions: Social Security 100% exempt (G.S. 105-153.5(b)(3)); private IRA/401(k)/RMD withdrawals and the FULL taxable Roth conversion taxed as ordinary income at the flat rate (no age/source condition); dividends + short- AND long-term gains ordinary (no LTCG preference); no local/municipal income tax statewide. OUT (named in the constants, never modeled): Bailey govt-plan carve-out, military-retirement deduction, muni add-backs. UNCHANGED by S.L. 2026-41.

note: PINNED 2026-08-02, retiring the 2026-07-15 hawk veto. The veto held 3.99% forward for one stated reason -- the reported budget-deal schedule 'could not be located to primary session law.' It is located: S.L. 2026-41 § 44.1(a). WHAT CHANGED BEYOND THE RATES: the same section also rewrote the § 105-153.7(a1) revenue-trigger table, STRIKING every row from FY2025-26 through FY2032-33. The FY2025-26 certification this record previously waited on therefore no longer gates anything -- the first SURVIVING trigger row is FY2033-34 -> TY2035, the step shrank from 0.50pp to 0.25pp, and the 2.49% floor is unchanged. Next live-flip checkpoint is consequently the Office of the State Controller's AUGUST-2034 final accounting, a decade out; nothing before then can move these rates except another session law. The 2033+ 2.99% tail is pinned (not directional) because the only surviving mechanism that can move it can only CUT -- so the statutory rate and the conservative direction agree. SOURCE LANDMINE: NCDOR's tax-rate-schedules page still shows the struck 'after 2025 -- 3.99%' citing SL 2023-134, and ncleg's CODIFIED G.S. 105-153.7 page had not recompiled as of the pin date. Both will read as CONTRADICTING this record until they catch up -- session law wins; do NOT 'correct' the table back to 3.99% flat. VAULT IMPACT: adding the steps moves the StateTaxVintageV3 stamp (it fingerprints the whole serialized schedule), so saved NC vaults stale on unlock by design -- the out-years they priced genuinely changed. nextDue is now the ANNUAL drift cadence (the PA/FL posture), not a pending-event checkpoint.
